about: Planning an offsite. One factual question goes unanswered and should be looked up; one is answered by a person and one is rhetorical, so those should not.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: So for the offsite we were thinking Lisbon in March.

lines.speaker: Jo
lines.text: I love that. What's the weather actually like there in March? Is it warm enough to be outside?

lines.speaker: Jo
lines.text: Okay. And how long is the flight from New York, roughly?

lines.speaker: Ravi
lines.text: About seven hours direct, I did it last year.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Budget wise, who knows what hotel prices will do by then.

lines.speaker: Ravi
lines.text: Yeah, it is what it is. We'll book early.

lines.speaker: Jo
lines.text: We should decide on the dates next week then.
